'''Beissa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was a trainer for the [[Smugglers' Alliance]] and could often be found at [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
